topic_title: How Alcohol and Other Drugs Affect Driving Ability
prompt: What dangerous physiological phenomenon occurs when alcohol is consumed in combination with drugs?

options.text: Chemical neutralization, where drugs cancel out the impairing effects of alcohol
Accelerated liver filtering, clearing both substances from the body much faster
The synergistic effect, where the combined substances multiply overall impairment
Temporary immunity from field sobriety eye nystagmus examination detections
